details.name: v6.21.2
details.body:
## v6.21.2 ### Highlights 已适配明日方舟 26.11.1 版本的游戏新界面，修复新版主界面下肉鸽与生息演算入口的识别问题。后续不做日间主题以外的主题适配；如需使用其他主题，可在任务列表末尾自行添加 ｢更换主题｣ 任务。 本版本按功能域全量重写了 WPF 语言资源，个别界面可能出现文案显示异常；如遇到问题，请通过 ｢设置 - 问题反馈｣ 提交反馈。 #### 设置指引改为任务设置演示教学，新增用户协议确认 设置指引 ｢任务设置｣ 步骤改为分步演示教学，按引导顺序完成任务配置；新增用户协议确认步骤，已完成旧版指引的用户升级后重新进入指引。 #### 生息演算迁移到 ｢小工具-牛杂｣，外服支持 ｢重启锚点｣ 生息演算从任务队列迁移到 ｢小工具-牛杂｣ 独立运行，任务队列中已有的条目与设置升级后自动迁入。YostarEN/JP/KR 新增支持 ｢重启锚点｣ 主题。 #### 黑流树海刷开局支持凹第一层实托邦 刷开局新增 ｢凹第一层实托邦｣ 选项，需难度 6 及以上。 #### 编队与选人提速 自动编队优先在当前页匹配待选干员，减少翻页；自定义基建与宿舍选人按职业分桶定位剩余目标干员。
English Adapted to the new UI in the Arknights 26.11.1 update, and fixed Roguelike and Reclamation Algorithm entry recognition on the new main screen. No themes other than Day will be adapted going forward; to use a different theme, add a ｢Switch Theme｣ task at the end of the task list. The WPF localization resources have been extensively rewritten by feature domain in this version; a few texts may display incorrectly. If you run into any, please report via Settings - Issue Report. #### First-Run Guide Revamped as Task Settings Demo Tutorial with User Agreement Confirmation The ｢Task Settings｣ step of the first-run guide is now a step-by-step demo tutorial that walks through task configuration in a guided order; a user agreement confirmation step has been added, and users who completed the old guide will go through the new one again after upgrading. #### Reclamation Algorithm Moved to Toolbox "Useful Tasks", "RELAUNCH ANCHOR" on Overseas Servers Reclamation Algorithm now runs standalone in the Toolbox "Useful Tasks" section; existing entries in the task queue are migrated automatically with their settings preserved. YostarEN/JP/KR now support the "RELAUNCH ANCHOR" theme. #### BlackFlow Start Run: Reroll Until Floor 1 is 实托邦 New option for start-run farming to reroll until Floor 1 is 实托邦 (a Floor 1 variant); requires difficulty 6 or above. #### Faster Formation and Operator Selection Auto formation now matches operators on the current page first, reducing paging; custom infrast and dormitory selection locate remaining targets by class.
